package.description: High performance, multi-platform VNC client and server

en-US.description: High performance, multi-platform VNC client and server
en-US.longDescription: TigerVNC is a high-performance, platform-neutral implementation of VNC (Virtual Network Computing), a client/server application that allows users to launch and interact with graphical applications on remote machines. TigerVNC provides the levels of performance necessary to run 3D and video applications, and it attempts to maintain a common look and feel and re-use components, where possible, across the various platforms that it supports. TigerVNC also provides extensions for advanced authentication methods and TLS encryption.
en-US.name: TigerVNC

zh-CN.description: 高性能、跨平台的 VNC 客户端和服务器
zh-CN.longDescription: TigerVNC 是 VNC（Virtual Network Computing）的一个高性能、平台中立的实现。VNC 是一种客户端/服务器应用程序，允许用户在远程机器上启动图形应用程序并与之交互。TigerVNC 可提供运行 3D 和视频应用程序所需的性能水平，并尽可能在其支持的各种平台上保持外观一致并复用组件。TigerVNC 还提供高级身份验证方法和 TLS 加密等扩展功能。
zh-CN.name: TigerVNC
